title: Repeated misunderstandings lead to a clarifying question before advice

turns.user: You treated my comment about rent as if I meant a gift. That was a misunderstanding.
You also thought I wanted advice about the lease when I asked you to listen. That was another misunderstanding.
A third time: you assumed I had already decided to move. I never said that.

reply.judge: Asks at least one clarifying question about Saturday before laying out a plan or list of advice. Does not pretend to already know what they want Saturday to be.
